name: al.toyshub/catalog
title: Toys Hub
description: Browse Toys Hub: products, prices in ALL, stock, delivery and checkout links. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Toys Hub's catalogue by words, category, age and price. Returns name, price, availability, photo, product page and a buy-now link for each match.

query.description: Words to look for in names and descriptions (Albanian or English). Empty lists popular products.

age.description: Child's age in years; returns products suitable for that age.

max_price.description: Highest price, in the store currency.

in_stock_only.description: true: only products that can be bought now (in stock).

limit.description: How many products to return, 1 to 50.

lang.description: Language of names, descriptions and links: "sq" Albanian, "en" English.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything about one product: description, price, availability, age range, brand, photos, rating, delivery and payment facts, and a buy-now link.

lang.description: Language of names, descriptions and links: "sq" Albanian, "en" English.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All product categories with their slug, name, product count and page.

lang.description: Language of names, descriptions and links: "sq" Albanian, "en" English.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Who the store is and how buying works: delivery countries, cost and time, payment methods, returns, currency, languages and contact.

lang.description: Language of names, descriptions and links: "sq" Albanian, "en" English.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Whether a product can be ordered now in the wanted quantity.

quantity.description: How many the shopper wants; the answer says whether that many are in stock.

tools.name: get_shipping_quote
tools.description: Delivery cost and time for a city, and whether the order qualifies for free delivery.

city.description: Delivery city, e.g. Tirana or Prishtina.

order_total.description: Value of the products, in the store currency.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Make a link that opens Toys Hub's checkout with these products already in the cart. Give it to the shopper; they confirm and pay on the store's site. Nothing is ordered or stored by this tool.

items.description: The products to put in the cart, each with its quantity.

quantity.description: How many of this product, 1 to 20.

lang.description: Language of names, descriptions and links: "sq" Albanian, "en" English.
